create_tensorlist_from_offsets_and_data: create a TensorList from offset and data tensors to manage variable-length tensor sequences
concatenate_tensorlists_with_cat: concatenate multiple TensorList instances into a single TensorList using the cat class method
convert_tensorlist_to_padded_tensor: convert a TensorList of variable-length tensors into a padded 2D tensor with a specified padding value
convert_padded_tensor_to_tensorlist: convert a padded 2D tensor back into a TensorList using the from_padded class method
index_and_slice_tensorlist: index a TensorList with a LongTensor, int, or slice to extract specific tensor elements
